description: This PHP source file defines the LicenseFileAPI class, which extends an abstract REST controller to handle API requests related to license file content retrieval within the OrangeHRM installer module.

classes.name: LicenseFileAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class responsible for returning the contents of the LICENSE file in the system when handling GET requests.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET HTTP requests to retrieve the LICENSE file content. It reads the file based on the base directory configuration and returns its contents in an array.
